text:
3/ Step 2:

Go to @Vidfield

Then:
→ Go inside canvas
→ Upload that image
→ choose Seedance 2
→ generate the video

That’s it.

check Seedance 2.0 prompt below 👇 https://t.co/p2v9BhtQPb
content: Go to Vidfield, open the canvas, upload your image, select Seedance 2, and generate the video.

translations.es: Ve a Vidfield, abre el lienzo, sube tu imagen, selecciona Seedance 2 y genera el video.
translations.fr: Allez sur Vidfield, ouvrez le canevas, téléchargez votre image, sélectionnez Seedance 2, et générez la vidéo.
translations.ja: Vidfieldにアクセスし、キャンバスを開き、画像をアップロードし、Seedance 2を選択してビデオを生成します。
translations.ko: Vidfield로 이동하여 캔버스를 열고 이미지를 업로드한 후 Seedance 2를 선택하고 비디오를 생성하세요.
translations.pt-BR: Vá para o Vidfield, abra a tela, faça o upload da sua imagem, selecione Seedance 2 e gere o vídeo.
translations.zh-CN: 前往Vidfield，打开画布，上传你的图像，选择Seedance 2，然后生成视频。
